Method: (1) Serialize P1-P8 + reassurance paragraph into a private review brief (mktemp under scratchpad, chmod 0600) that does NOT assert findings are correct; brief states requested outcome (find anything wrong/overstated/understated/missing/mis-sized in severity/remediation; do not fix), exact revision (develop ed4907010), scope=change (four commits + corpus creation results-data/, benchbox/validation/bundle.py, benchbox/core/publishing/ + explorer publication _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/, results-explorer/), and required output contract (severity table with file:line evidence). (2) Create one dedicated detached worktree per reviewer at ed4907010 outside repo under scratchpad dir per isolation protocol. (3) Dispatch in parallel with timeout: agy Soft Read-Only Tier-1: cd $REVIEW_WT_AGY && agy --model gemini-3.7-flash-high --effort high --mode plan --print=$BRIEF_PATH; muse Hard Read-Only Tier-2 (tops out Tier-2): env -u META_API_KEY muse exec --workspace $REVIEW_WT_MUSE --disable-approval --disable-write --disable-shell --model muse-spark-1.2 --reasoning-effort high $BRIEF_PATH. (4) Verify clean (git status --porcelain), drop findings from dirty worktrees, remove worktrees + brief, report responder/timeout/failed/dropped status.
